regex.cycleCutMeaning: complete interactions with the cycles cut: going down the hierarchy and back up (zoom out, back, background); shortcuts (jumps to a state of another branch) are not expanded in the regex and are listed in regex.cycles.shortcutTransitions

cycles.meaning: spanning tree from the initial state (by hierarchical name when there is one, otherwise by BFS): tree = from parent to child, back = to an ancestor (closes a cycle), shortcut = to another branch
